@responses.activate
def test_tc_glovia_001_sales_order_happy_path(valid_sales_order_xml):
    # OneWay SOAP endpoint responds 202 Accepted upon successful handoff to mapping & end event
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        TEST_ENDPOINT,
        body="<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><SOAP:Body/></SOAP:Envelope>",
        status=202,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "SAP-Processing-Route": "SequenceFlow_82",
            "SAP-CustomHeader-BusinessObject": "SalesOrder",
            "SAP-CustomHeader-Country": "US",
            "SAP-CustomHeader-Region": "AMER",
            "SAP-CustomHeader-Sender": "Glovia"
        }
    )

    response = requests.post(TEST_ENDPOINT, data=valid_sales_order_xml, headers=SOAP_HEADERS, timeout=10)
    assert response.status_code == 202
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-Processing-Route") == "SequenceFlow_82"
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-CustomHeader-BusinessObject") == "SalesOrder"
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-CustomHeader-Country") == "US"

def test_tc_glovia_002_sales_order_return_route(return_sales_order_xml):

    assert response.headers.get("SAP-CustomHeader-BusinessObject") == "SalesOrderReturn"

@responses.activate
def test_tc_glovia_003_routing_default_escalation(unmatched_order_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        TEST_ENDPOINT,
        body="<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><SOAP:Body><SOAP:Fault><faultcode>SOAP:Client</faultcode><faultstring>Escalation: RoutingConditionNotMet</faultstring></SOAP:Fault></SOAP:Body></SOAP:Envelope>",
        status=200,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "SAP-Escalation-Code": "RoutingConditionNotMet",
            "SAP-Processing-Route": "SequenceFlow_110"
        }
    )

    response = requests.post(TEST_ENDPOINT, data=unmatched_order_xml, headers=SOAP_HEADERS, timeout=10)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-Escalation-Code") == "RoutingConditionNotMet"
    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    fault_string = root.find(".//{http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/}faultstring")
    assert fault_string is not None
    assert "RoutingConditionNotMet" in fault_string.text

@responses.activate
def test_tc_glovia_004_mapping_error_subprocess():
    corrupted_payload = "<SOAP:Envelope><SOAP:Body><Corrupt/></SOAP:Body></SOAP:Envelope>"
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        TEST_ENDPOINT,
        body="<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><SOAP:Body><SOAP:Fault><faultcode>SOAP:Server</faultcode><faultstring>Processing Error</faultstring></SOAP:Fault></SOAP:Body></SOAP:Envelope>",
        status=500,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml",
            "SAP-ErrorSubprocess-Executed": "SubProcess_91",
            "SAP-Payload-Restored": "true",
            "SAP-Log-Attachment": "Payload"
        }
    )

    response = requests.post(TEST_ENDPOINT, data=corrupted_payload, headers=SOAP_HEADERS, timeout=10)
    assert response.status_code == 500
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-ErrorSubprocess-Executed") == "SubProcess_91"
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-Payload-Restored") == "true"
    assert response.headers.get("SAP-Log-Attachment") == "Payload"

@responses.activate
def test_tc_glovia_005_network_timeout_handling(valid_sales_order_xml):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        TEST_ENDPOINT,
        body=requests.exceptions.Timeout("Simulated gateway timeout")
    )

    with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.Timeout):
        requests.post(TEST_ENDPOINT, data=valid_sales_order_xml, headers=SOAP_HEADERS, timeout=1)

risks.consequence: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier for OrganizationId) exist in the BPMN model but have no sequence flow connections. Expected validations or validations for OrderCodeValid are not executed during runtime, potentially routing invalid orders.
risks.mitigation: Automated pipeline tests verify that routing decisions depend directly on explicit XML elements or externalized parameters. A lint check flags unconnected nodes in CI before deployment.

risks.risk: Escalation EndEvent silently halting message delivery
risks.consequence: EndEvent_11 raises an escalation 'RoutingConditionNotMet'. Because returnExceptionToSender is set to false in collaboration properties, the sender receives a normal acknowledgment while the message stops without error escalation or receiver dispatch.
risks.mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_003 specifically checks the escalation path and asserts that the escalation code is logged in the Message Processing Log (MPL) to trigger alerting.

risks.consequence: If Message Mapping fails due to unexpected XML constructs or schema deviations, the enriched message body could be lost or incomplete for reprocessing.
risks.mitigation: CallActivity_4 sets ${in.body} into property 'InputPayload' immediately at entry. CallActivity_97 and CallActivity_100 ensure the original payload is restored and appended as an attachment in MPL before ErrorEndEvent EndEvent_95 is reached (covered by TC_GLOVIA_004).

risks.consequence: ParallelGateway_74 is configured as a Parallel Multicast but only contains one outgoing flow (SequenceFlow_109) to ExclusiveGateway_80. If another branch is added without a join gateway, race conditions and duplicate executions occur.
risks.mitigation: Coverage analysis and unit assertions ensure that message sequencing is validated and single-branch routing behavior remains deterministic.

uncovered_paths: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) are disconnected in the BPMN process definition and unreachable via sequence flows from StartEvent_2.
coverage_recommendations: Connect CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 into the main sequence flow between CallActivity_4 and ParallelGateway_74 if order validation and organization ID extraction are business requirements.
If CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 are obsolete artifacts, delete them from the iFlow model to achieve true 100% executable model coverage.
